metadata.title: FasalMitra Global Agricultural Taxonomy & Data Provenance Registry
metadata.description: Authoritative institutional registry establishing data provenance, biological host-pathogen vectors, chemical label claims, safety thresholds, and citation attribution across global and Indian agro-ecological zones.

banned_and_restricted_chemicals_registry.status: Completely Banned in India (Hon'ble Supreme Court Order & Stockholm Convention)
banned_and_restricted_chemicals_registry.action: Immediate Refusal & Safety Warning; substitute with integrated bio-control or safe CIB&RC synthetic alternatives.

banned_and_restricted_chemicals_registry.status: Banned on Vegetables; strictly restricted in field crops
banned_and_restricted_chemicals_registry.action: Refusal on all vegetable and horticulture queries; recommend safe neonicotinoid or diamide alternatives.

banned_and_restricted_chemicals_registry.status: Restricted use under strict supervision; not for tank mixing with insecticides/fungicides
banned_and_restricted_chemicals_registry.toxicity_class: Class II (Severe caustic poison with fatal pulmonary toxicity)
banned_and_restricted_chemicals_registry.action: Refusal for foliar pest management or unapproved tank mixes.

banned_and_restricted_chemicals_registry.status: Restricted/Under phase-out review by Ministry of Agriculture Expert Committee
banned_and_restricted_chemicals_registry.action: Abstain from recommending broadcast application; advise seed treatments or bio-nematicides.

major_targets.pathogen: Complex of Fusarium spp., Colletotrichum gossypii, Xanthomonas malvacearum, and Rhizopus spp.
major_targets.management: Copper Oxychloride 50 WP (2.5 g/L) + Streptocycline (100 ppm) or Propiconazole 25 EC (1 ml/L); avoid waterlogging.

major_targets.damage: Sap sucking, honeydew excretion causing sooty mold, vector for Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV)
major_targets.management: Yellow sticky traps (15-20/acre), Diafenthiuron 50 WP (1.2 g/L) or Pyriproxyfen 10 EC (2 ml/L) or Spiromesifen 22.9 SC (1.5 ml/L).

major_targets.etl: 8 moths/trap/night for 3 consecutive nights or 10% rosette flowers/green bolls
major_targets.management: Pheromone traps (Gossyplure), release of Trichogramma bactrae, Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC (0.3 ml/L) or Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG (0.5 g/L).

major_targets.pathogen: Rhizoctonia bataticola (Macrophomina phaseolina) and Rhizoctonia solani
major_targets.symptoms: Yellowing, wilting, complete bark shredding on taproot
major_targets.management: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride (10 g/kg) + soil drenching with Carbendazim 50 WP (1 g/L) or Copper Oxychloride (2.5 g/L).

major_targets.syndromes: Leaf blast (spindle shaped lesions), Node blast, Neck blast (broken panicle neck with sterile grains)
major_targets.management: Tricyclazole 75 WP (0.6 g/L) or Isoprothiolane 40 EC (1.5 ml/L) or Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC (1 ml/L).

major_targets.symptoms: Water-soaked yellow wavy streaks beginning from leaf margin towards tip, bacterial ooze drops in morning
major_targets.management: Streptocycline (6 g/acre) + Copper Oxychloride 50 WP (500 g/acre); avoid excessive nitrogen application.

major_targets.syndromes: Dead heart at vegetative stage, White ear head at reproductive stage
major_targets.management: Chlorantraniliprole 0.4 GR (4 kg/acre) or Cartap Hydrochloride 50 SP (2 g/L) or Flubendiamide 39.35 SC (0.2 ml/L).

major_targets.symptoms: White to grey talcum-like powdery pustules on leaf blades and sheaths
major_targets.management: Propiconazole 25 EC (1 ml/L) or Wettable Sulphur 80 WDG (3 g/L).

major_targets.pathogen: Puccinia striiformis (Stripe/Yellow), P. triticina (Brown/Leaf), P. graminis (Black/Stem)
major_targets.management: Tebuconazole 25.9 EC (1 ml/L) or Propiconazole 25 EC (1 ml/L) at first sign of yellow rust pustules.

major_targets.damage: Hollow stems with soil galleries, seedlings drying in patches
major_targets.management: Seed treatment with Chlorpyrifos 20 EC or Thiamethoxam 30 FS; irrigation and soil drenching.
Foliar spray of Thiamethoxam 25 WG (0.3 g/L) or Acetamiprid 20 SP (0.4 g/L) to manage vector; rouging infected plants.

major_targets.symptoms: Parallel double ring cuts on petiole/stem causing wilting above the girdle
major_targets.management: Thiamethoxam 12.6% + Lambda Cyhalothrin 9.5% ZC (0.3 ml/L) or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC (0.3 ml/L).

major_targets.pathogen: Cercospora arachidicola (Early leaf spot) and Phaeoisariopsis personata (Late leaf spot)
major_targets.symptoms: Dark brown/black spots surrounded by yellow chlorotic halo
major_targets.management: Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP (2 g/L) or Hexaconazole 5 EC (1.5 ml/L).

major_targets.symptoms: Black fungal spores at collar region near soil surface, seedling collapse
major_targets.management: Seed treatment with Trichoderma harzianum (10 g/kg) or Thiram + Carbendazim (3 g/kg).

major_targets.symptoms: Target-board concentric rings on leaves and fruit stem ends
major_targets.management: Mancozeb 75 WP (2.5 g/L) or Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole (1 ml/L).

major_targets.symptoms: Rapid water-soaked lesions turning black overnight, white downy mold under humid conditions
major_targets.management: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (2.5 g/L) or Dimethomorph 50 WP (1 g/L).
Nursery nylon netting (40 mesh), Imidacloprid 17.8 SL (0.5 ml/L).

major_targets.vector: Thrips (Scirtothrips dorsalis) causing upward curl, Mites (Polyphagotarsonemus latus) causing downward curl
major_targets.management: Fipronil 5 SC (2 ml/L) for thrips; Fenazaquin 10 EC (2 ml/L) or Spiromesifen (1 ml/L) for yellow mites.

major_targets.symptoms: Water-soaked girdling of seedling stems at nursery soil line, seedling falling over
major_targets.management: Raised nursery beds, seed treatment with Trichoderma, nursery drenching with Copper Oxychloride (2.5 g/L).

major_targets.symptoms: Reddish-brown circular sunken lesions on cladodes (stems) and fruit rind
major_targets.management: Azoxystrobin 23 SC (1 ml/L) or Copper Oxychloride 50 WP (2.5 g/L); proper trellis pruning for airflow.
Bordeaux mixture 1% spray; remove infected cladodes with sterilized shears.

primary_institutions: ICAR-National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (NBPGR)

major_targets.symptoms: Pale chlorotic spots on upper leaf surface with grey-violaceous sporulation on underside
major_targets.management: Mancozeb (2.5 g/L) or Metalaxyl-M; ensure wide plant spacing.
Neem oil 10,000 ppm (3 ml/L) or Flonicamid 50 WG (0.3 g/L).

primary_institutions: SKUAST Kashmir - Advanced Research Station for Saffron & Seed Spices

major_targets.pathogen: Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. gladioli and Rhizoctonia crocorum
major_targets.symptoms: Sunken dark brown spots on corm scales, rotting of apical buds, stunted yellow foliage
major_targets.management: Corm dip treatment in Carbendazim 50 WP (1 g/L) + Mancozeb (2 g/L) for 20 minutes before planting; solarize raised beds.
Trichoderma harzianum soil application enriched in farmyard manure (FYM).

major_targets.symptoms: Small brittle black feeder roots, canopy dieback, yellowing wilt
major_targets.management: Potassium phosphonate (Fosetyl-Al) soil drench and trunk injection; plant on mounds with excellent drainage.
Copper fungicides post-flowering and during fruit development.

primary_institutions: TNAU Horticultural College and Research Institute, Periyakulam

major_targets.symptoms: Oozing of gum from drumstick pods, internal rotting and premature pod drying
major_targets.management: Collect and destroy fallen pods, soil application of Neem cake (250 kg/ha), spray Malathion 50 EC (1 ml/L) or Spinosad 45 SC (0.3 ml/L).

major_targets.symptoms: Gregarious caterpillars defoliating trees, forming large clusters on tree trunks
major_targets.management: Burning caterpillar clusters with torch, spray Chlorpyrifos 20 EC (2 ml/L) or Dichlorvos (1 ml/L).

primary_institutions: Indian Cardamom Research Institute (ICRI), Spices Board, Myladumpara

major_targets.symptoms: Silvery scabs and warts on capsule surface (panicle thrips), stunted pseudostems
major_targets.management: Quinalphos 25 EC (2 ml/L) or Spinetoram 11.7 SC (0.5 ml/L); apply during flowering and early capsule formation.

major_targets.symptoms: Water-soaked rotting of immature capsules, shredding of leaf sheaths
major_targets.management: 1% Bordeaux mixture spray or Copper Oxychloride (2.5 g/L) drenching in panicle zones before monsoon onset.

major_targets.symptoms: Browning and decaying of aerial and terrestrial roots, flaccid yellow vines
major_targets.management: Bio-control with Trichoderma harzianum; drenching with Carbendazim (1 g/L) or Potassium Phosphonate (3 ml/L).

primary_institutions: ICAR-Directorate of Medicinal and Aromatic Plants Research (DMAPR), Anand

major_targets.management: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride (10 g/kg) + soil incorporation of well-rotted FYM; avoid water stagnation.
